Apparently Silicon Valley has a new idea for compensation.

Not salary.
Not bonus.
Not equity.

Now they want to pay software engineers in AI compute tokens.

Yes… tokens. Because running AI models costs money, some companies are floating the idea of giving engineers “AI compute credits” as part of their pay package.

So your compensation might look like:
Salary
Bonus
Equity
…and prompt tokens.
